fusions.name: Tempered Taps
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 8 damage, leaves the target [Bruised] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Quench Shock
fusions.desc: Drives a shock of cold force through a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 30 damage to everything in it and ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Turned on the Anvil
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 50% of the elemental damage you take is turned back on whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Case Hardening
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8, they all spend at once on a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack.
